title: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M: the staged MTP verifier's short-context leaf is restored to the row's own live count, restoring AR identity and the 2x serving win
purpose: Record the fix for the MTP exactness regression that the matched serving baseline exposed, the route evidence that localizes it, and the same-lane serving rate after the fix.
hardware: zbook, Ryzen AI MAX+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S (gfx1151)
server_command: python -m hipengine.server --model Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1151 --max-context-tokens 8192 --kv-storage bf16 --execution-profile production --speculative-mtp-serving auto --speculative-candidate-budget 3

root_cause.commit: 085bdd86b perf: stage long-context verifier rows on per-row exact attention leaves
root_cause.change: The staged full-attention verifier chain's per-row branch used to launch the plain span leaf (qwen35_paged_full_attn_decode_context_bf16_spans with the span-wide attention_context_limit, a leaf whose loop is bounded by the row's own live count). The commit made it reproduce the scalar owner's short-context batch leaf (_full_attn_decode_short_batch_fn), which takes the row's position + 1 cap as a scalar argument instead of reading a live count.
root_cause.why_gfx1151_only: The substitution only fires where the backend publishes GGUF_SHORT_C1_BATCH_ATTN_MAX_CONTEXT: hip_gfx1151 publishes 1023, hip_gfx1100 publishes nothing, so every unit test on the default backend kept passing while the executed kernel changed on the serving host.
root_cause.why_the_cap_is_wrong_on_this_route: The cap comes from row_scratch.position_host, a host mirror. The eager verifier stages the metadata it reads back, but the captured target graph updates positions on device, so the mirror is a capture-time value rather than the row's live count. The plain span leaf is immune because it reads the live count from the spans.

executed_route_evidence.method: temporary HIPENGINE_ROUTE_TRACE instrumentation in the session, the layer router, and the staged chain, on the shipping server during the divergent request
executed_route_evidence.session: rows=4 start=14 end=18 mode=native views=True limit=1023 scalar_caps=False
executed_route_evidence.layer: layer=3 full rows=4 start=14 limit=1023 views=True strict=False staged_linear=False staged_full=True
executed_route_evidence.staged_chain: rows=4 limit=1023 quant=None batch_fn=False shared=False split_rows=False
executed_route_evidence.reading: views=True with end=18 cannot come from the eager view builder (its own context_limit gate declines spans below 1,024), so the views are the captured target graph's. batch_fn=False because the bf16_context_batch_shared_native_exact_spans variant resolves only for the gguf_q4_k_m/gguf_ud_q3_k_m quant keys and _gguf_prefill_quant is None on this path, and split_rows=False, so the per-row branch is the executed one.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: The commit's eager view synthesis (_eager_native_row_views) reached short batches and moved them onto the staged route.
rejected_hypotheses.measurement: gated the builder on the batch's own reach (start_position + rows) instead of the span end; the ladder stayed at shared prefix 7 of 16

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: The staged_dense_full gate accepted any resolvable row set, so short batches moved off the row-wise route.
rejected_hypotheses.measurement: gated the staged route on the batch crossing the split boundary; the ladder stayed at shared prefix 7 of 16

fix.change: The staged full-attention chain takes row_views_have_scalar_caps from its caller and launches the short-context batch leaf only under that guarantee; otherwise it launches the plain span leaf. Rows at or above the split threshold keep the commit's per-row split-K leaf selection.
fix.caller_guarantee: Qwen35GGUFResidentSession sets row_views_keep_scalar_caps when its own eager builder staged the row metadata (_eager_native_row_views); the captured target graph passes its device-driven views without the guarantee.
fix.why_not_drop_the_leaf_entirely: The plain leaf everywhere fails the long-context gate's per-row teacher parity: all five straddling direct cases report target_logits_exact=False, against 5 of 5 passing with the caller guarantee.

serving_ladder.protocol: non-streaming and streaming chat completions, greedy, max_tokens 8/16/32, both stream_options settings, same server flags and host

budgets.32: diverges at token 14 on the raw completions arm only (pre-existing)

long_context_gate.fixed_tree: 6 of 6 direct cases pass with target_logits_exact, hidden_exact, kv_rows_exact and linear_state_exact true; split-K calls 16 per case at cycle end 1024 and 32 at 1025, matching the commit's retained run
long_context_gate.plain_leaf_everywhere: 5 of 5 straddling cases completed before the run was stopped report target_logits_exact=False

unit_test.name: tests/test_live_gguf_native_spec_cycle.py::test_staged_full_attention_below_threshold_leaf_follows_the_caller_guarantee
unit_test.red: on the unfixed head the recorded calls are ['attn_short'] * 4 against the expected plain-leaf calls
unit_test.green: with the fix, graph-style views take the plain span leaf with the span limit and caller-guaranteed views take the batch leaf with the row's own cap 12..15

changes: the single-prompt identity cases pin the autoregressive arm with speculative_mtp: false instead of leaving the field to the server's automatic policy; on a configuration whose automatic scope is promoted the unpinned request runs the speculative route too, so the old comparison measured two speculative arms against each other
the ladder covers 8 and 16 tokens by default (32 by --identity-budgets) and reports ids_exact_by_budget, first_divergent_budget and first_divergent_index

new --max-context-tokens / --kv-storage / --execution-profile flags, because the identity cases only reach the staged verifier route on a context budget above the split threshold: the gate's historical configuration (no budget pinned) reports exact on the unfixed head, which is why the 8-token case could not see the regression

red_green_serving_config.config: max_context_tokens=8192, kv_storage=bf16, execution_profile=production, speculative_mtp_serving=auto, candidate budget resolved from retained evidence
red_green_serving_config.protocol: the gate's own request sequence through TestClient, both lifecycles (eager_load true and false), identity budgets 8 and 16
red_green_serving_config.reading: All four identity rows move from failing to exact in both lifecycles, which is the RED/GREEN for the fix on a protocol independent of the retained serving ladder.

diagnostic_budget_32.note: 32 is not part of the default ladder
diagnostic_budget_32.classification: The fixed tree's 32-token divergence on the raw completions arm is the control tree's own divergence, not a new one: both emit four 248045 tokens under true AR and three under MTP, after which the arms track each other exactly. It is the same late, prompt-dependent class the 2026-09-18 exactness entry recorded at tokens 47 and 155 on two of seven natural prompts, and it belongs to the production numerical envelope (KL, top-1) rather than to byte identity, which is why the default ladder stops at 16.

red_green_serving_config.gate_verdict_note: The gate's overall verdict is False on every tree here for rows unrelated to this change, and those rows already failed before it: the identity rows require auto_reason == automatic_mtp_scope_not_promoted and an autoregressive arm with no draft counters, which a configuration with promoted automatic MTP does not report; thinking_policy and explicit_rejections expect HTTP 400 where this model and configuration answer 200; capability_and_readiness compares the retained Qwen3.6 evidence set. The identity fields (ids_exact, ids_exact_by_budget, first_divergent_budget) are the rows this change owns.

postfix_serving_baseline.protocol: scripts/sharegpt_mtp_routing_pass.py, ShareGPT_V3_unfiltered_cleaned_split.json, 6 prompts, c=1, --max-total-len 1024, natural output lengths, greedy, one warmup discarded, --record-ids, one server process per arm, HIPENGINE_MTP2_OUTPUT_SPANS=1
postfix_serving_baseline.comparison_basis: same host, same server flags, same prompts and consumer protocol as benchmarks/results/2026-09-18-gfx1151-qwen38-sharegpt-natural-serving-baseline.json

reading.headline: The fix restores both contracts the regression broke. AR identity returns on the ladder (8/16/32 exact on both arms, against 7 of 16 shared at the head) and the matched c=1 serving lane returns to 23.46 tok/s against true AR's 11.74 (2.00x, 99.7% MTP share), where the head measured 9.37 against 11.75 (0.80x). Accepted drafts per cycle move from 0.10-0.24 at the head to 2.04 of a budget of 3, which is the expected direction when the verifier stops rejecting proposals the target model itself would make.
reading.not_claimed: The control tree's residual late divergence (2 of 7 natural prompts, tokens 47 and 155) is a property of this verifier route that the fix restores rather than removes; it still needs the production numerical envelope (KL, top-1 by category) before it is called acceptable. The c=2/c=4 lanes and the long-prompt pair were not re-measured.
reading.residual: The control tree's late divergence is now classified for one case: the 32-token raw-completions arm differs by one repetition token on the control tree and on the fixed tree identically, so it is a property of this verifier route rather than of the regression or its fix.
